label: Material
tagline: Physical-property fidelity - glass refracts, clay deforms, holo shifts, halftone prints, glitch tears
description: POST-PASS material-fidelity orchestrator. Runs AFTER visual-orchestrator + creative-visual-orchestrator, BEFORE interactive-polish-orchestrator + Step-8 QA. Walks source HTML + CSS, identifies elements that wear a material aesthetic (cards / panels / buttons / hero / borders / type / image bg / decorative shapes), and commits a fidelity pass that makes the material FEEL like the real thing - multi-layer shadows + backdrop-filter tuning + SVG filter primitives + WebGL shaders + reactive-light-direction wired to pointer / DeviceOrientation / scroll / hover. Reads docs/research/material-library.md (78 curated entries spanning digital UI surfaces - glass / liquid-glass / claymorphism / neumorphism / holographic-foil / chrome-mirror / brushed-aluminum / aurora-mesh / Frutiger glossy-plastic / skeuomorphism; digital media textures - pixel-bitmap / CRT-phosphor / ANSI-art / 1bit-dither / datamosh / RGB-channel-split / JPEG-corruption / signal-interference / NES-ROM-corruption / chromatic-aberration-lens / barrel-pincushion / displacement-ripple / heat-haze / motion-blur / plotter-pen-line / CAD-blueprint / wireframe-3d-line / schematic-PCB / iso-line-drawing / hand-architect-sketch / monospace-code-grid; analog materials - paper families uncoated/coated/kraft/parchment/vellum, print families halftone-CMYK/risograph/silkscreen/letterpress-emboss/photocopy-xerox, drawing families pencil-graphite/charcoal/ink-bleed/watercolor-wash/sumi-e/Polaroid-instant, fabric/leather families linen/denim/silk/corduroy/felt/pebbled-leather/smooth-leather/weathered-leather, film/video families Tri-X/Portra-400/CineStill-800T/VHS-distortion/film-grain, distress families dust-scratches/foxing-stain/torn-edge, wood/stone - walnut-grain/marble/concrete; hybrid cross-overs - scanned-glass/risograph-glass/VHS-frutiger/chrome-on-velvet). For each material-bearing element, picks one material from the library by consulting the §7 decision tree against the committed prototype slug, generates CSS / SVG filter primitives / GLSL shader / raster texture / video texture / JS reactive bootstrap, commits implementation to source/<branch>/_material/composite.{css,js}. OPTIONAL - fires when the committed prototype aesthetic is material-bearing per the library decision tree OR explicit user request. Reactive budget (subtle / rich / theatrical) controls how much input-driven reactivity wires in; gyro is permission-gated behind a single user gesture; prefers-reduced-motion always honoured. Cold-isolated per project.

triggers.title: Material-fidelity pass (LATE - after visual + creative-visual, before polish)
triggers.rule: After visual-orchestrator and (if it ran) creative-visual-orchestrator have committed, AND the committed prototype style/aesthetic is material-bearing per docs/research/material-library.md §7 decision tree (style-glassmorphism, style-liquid-glass, style-claymorphism, style-neumorphism, style-holographic, style-skeuomorphism, style-neubrutalism, style-material-m3, style-aurorism, style-raster-cutout, aesthetic-frutiger-aero, aesthetic-frutiger-chromecore, aesthetic-frutiger-dark-aero, aesthetic-frutiger-eco, aesthetic-cottagecore, aesthetic-vaporwave, aesthetic-lo-fi, aesthetic-mixtape, aesthetic-zine, aesthetic-cyberpunk, aesthetic-cassette-futurism, aesthetic-bauhaus, aesthetic-dark-academia, aesthetic-pixel-*, aesthetic-y2k-futurism, aesthetic-atompunk, and other material-bearing slugs), BEFORE interactive-polish-orchestrator + BEFORE Step-8 QA, chat-Claude dispatches material-orchestrator with project-wide scope. The orchestrator walks source, picks materials per element, surfaces a decision-request with reactive-budget choice (subtle/rich/theatrical), then commits CSS/SVG/WebGL/raster/video/JS implementation per element + a composite.css/composite.js per page. Also fires on explicit user request naming a material or material property ('make the glass feel real' / 'add reactive light' / 'the clay needs depth on press' / 'VHS distortion on the hero' / 'halftone the imagery' / 'glitch the typography' / 'datamosh the video bg' / 'make it feel like riso' / 'scanned-glass on the cards' / 'letterpress on the typography' / 'chromatic aberration on the headlines'). One consistent flow.
